title: Different cases, same key
objective: Find two distinct non-empty strings with the same default Unicode case fold.

inputs.label: Input B
inputs.description: A distinct spelling that folds the same way.

graphDescription: ICU4X applies full default case folding before comparing the results.
hints: Uppercase and lowercase ASCII letters already share folds.
Full folding can expand one scalar into several scalars.
explanation: Case folding is intended for caseless comparison, not display. Full folding may expand characters—German ß folds to ss—so distinct strings can share one comparison key.
